subject: general
question: Which of the following is a non-perishable food?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pulses**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Perishable foods are foods that spoil quickly within one or two days e.g., milk, curds, fish and meat.
 
• Semi perishable foods can last for 1–2 weeks. Examples are fruits and vegetables. Root crops like onions and potatoes last for 2–4 weeks.
 
• Non-perishable foods are those foods that generally last for one year e.g., grains like rice, wheat, pulses and dals, oilseeds.
